# Selected largest remainder core; consumed by the staged all-flows adapter.
# Inputs: requested whole persons, 13 integer capacities and nonnegative weights.
# Outputs: valid, allocation_00..12 and remaining (explicit unserved whole demand).
# Ties: ascending established age-band index. Zero weights receive no allocation.
# At most 13 saturation rounds and 13 final awards; never a per-person loop.
# Conservative arithmetic envelope: requested * each weight <= 10^12.
# Out-of-envelope input returns valid=0 and all demand unserved.
# Call cleanup only after consuming outputs. No demographic state is mutated.
